title: Client Reporting & Communication
objectives: Master the 5-point Client-Talk Formula for professional updates
Translate media buying metrics into business outcomes for CEOs and founders
Set healthy client expectations to prevent knee-jerk panic pauses

blocks.text: Being a great media buyer is only half the battle. Communicating clearly with clients is what keeps them for years!
Clients don't care about ad technicalities like EMQ or bid pacing. They care about customer acquisition cost, revenue, and cash flow.

blocks.title: The 5-Point Weekly Report Structure
items: 1. Executive Scorecard: Total Spend, Total Revenue, Blended ROAS / CPL, Customers Acquired
2. What Worked: Highlight the top-performing creative angle and why it succeeded
3. What Failed & What We Learned: Transparently explain tests that didn't hit benchmarks
4. Next Week's Test Plan: What new hooks, offers, or audiences are launching next
5. Client Action Items: Approvals needed or inventory warnings

blocks.title: The Doctor's Prescription
blocks.text: A good doctor doesn't hand you raw blood test spreadsheets with medical jargon. They say: 'Your cholesterol is down 10%. Keep taking this medication and I will see you in two weeks.' Talk like a marketing doctor!
The 24-Hour Rule: When performance dips, message the client first before they message you! Proactive communication builds immense trust.
Never guarantee fixed ROAS (like 'I promise 10x every week'). Advertising operates in dynamic auctions with changing competition and consumer demand.

quiz.q: What should be the very first section in a weekly performance report for a company founder?
options: The Executive Scorecard: Total spend, net revenue, blended CAC/CPL, and total new customers acquired
A biography of the media buyer
A screenshot of Ads Manager code
quiz.explain: Founders want to see commercial business impact first before reviewing creative details.

quiz.q: What is the '24-Hour Proactive Rule' when an unexpected ad performance drop occurs?
options: Delete the client's account within 24 hours
Alert the client with data and your diagnostic action plan before they notice and contact you in a panic
Wait 24 days to see if it fixes itself
Double the daily spend within 24 minutes
quiz.explain: Proactive communication demonstrates ownership and expertise, preventing client panic and retaining trust.

quiz.q: How should a performance marketer respond when a new client asks: 'Can you guarantee me a 10x ROAS?'
options: Say yes unconditionally to win the client
Explain commercial unit economics, share realistic benchmarks (2.5x-4x for cold traffic), and propose a phased 90-day testing roadmap
quiz.explain: Honest consultative alignment on realistic benchmarks establishes long-term credibility and avoids immediate failure.

quiz.q: True or False: Using the Client-Talk formula ('What happened, Why, Action taken, Next date') reassures non-technical stakeholders.
quiz.explain: True! It provides structure, clarity, and accountability without drowning the client in confusing jargon.

recap: Lead reports with commercial outcomes: Spend, Revenue, CPL, and CAC.
Be proactive during dips: communicate what happened, why, and your concrete fix.
